Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, json
p=pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
 {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"crash report","code":"Crash State: opt_cleanup bpf_optimize pcap_compile","note":"The report indicates a double-free reachable from pcap_compile through the optimizer cleanup path."},
 {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":804,"var":"bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf)","code":"if (optimize && !cstate.no_optimize) { if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1) { ... } }","note":"An input filter that reaches optimization drives execution into bpf_optimize."},
 {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1900,"var":"setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)","code":"if (setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)) { opt_cleanup(&opt_state); return -1; }","note":"Any opt_error later in optimization returns here and immediately frees optimizer allocations via opt_cleanup."},
 {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_init","line":2142,"var":"opt_state->blocks","code":"opt_state->blocks = (struct block **)calloc(n, sizeof(*opt_state->blocks));","note":"opt_init begins allocating the optimizer's heap-backed arrays."},
 {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_init","line":2161,"var":"opt_state->edges","code":"if (opt_state->edges == NULL) { free(opt_state->blocks); opt_error(opt_state, \"malloc\"); }","note":"If a later allocation fails, this path frees already-allocated memory and then longjmps out."},
 {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_error","line":2054,"var":"longjmp(opt_state->top_ctx, 1)","code":"longjmp(opt_state->top_ctx, 1);","note":"The longjmp re-enters bpf_optimize's handler, which calls opt_cleanup again on pointers already freed in opt_init, producing the heap double-free."}
]
p.write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('trace_written')
